recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度很高，正常造血幾乎被一片片瀰漫的未成熟細胞取代，細胞核呈卵圓到梭形、排列成束狀，只在下方邊緣殘留少量紅血球系與出血區，左上角可見骨小樑；在移植後的病人身上，這符合急性骨髓性白血病復發浸潤。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with diffuse effacement by sheets of immature mononuclear cells
Cells with ovoid to elongated/spindled nuclei in a vaguely fascicular, streaming arrangement
Fine chromatin and scant eosinophilic cytoplasm; individual nucleoli not resolved at this magnification
Few residual megakaryocytes and small foci of residual erythroid precursors and hemorrhage at the lower edge
Bony trabecula at upper left; fat spaces essentially absent
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low-to-intermediate power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with loss of fat spaces, adjacent to a bony trabecula. The marrow is diffusely replaced by sheets of immature cells with ovoid to spindled nuclei, fine chromatin, and scant cytoplasm arranged in a streaming, vaguely fascicular pattern. Residual normal hematopoiesis is limited to scattered megakaryocytes and small erythroid foci at the periphery. In the clinical context of prior AML and stem cell transplant, findings are suggestive of relapsed acute myeloid leukemia; spindled morphology warrants immunohistochemistry (CD34, CD117, MPO, lysozyme) and chimerism studies to confirm myeloid lineage and exclude a non-hematopoietic neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Metastatic sarcoma or spindle cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Spindled marrow infiltrates can mimic sarcoma, but relapsed AML is positive for CD34/CD117/MPO or lysozyme and negative for keratins and lineage-specific mesenchymal markers.
PTLD cells are usually round lymphoid cells or plasmacytoid/immunoblastic cells expressing CD20 or CD79a and often EBER, rather than myeloid markers.
Regenerating marrow shows trilineage maturation with erythroid islands and maturing granulocytes, not uniform sheets of immature cells.
Spindled mast cell aggregates are paratrabecular/perivascular with fibrosis and eosinophils and are CD117/tryptase/CD25 positive but CD34 and MPO negative.
